_note: Southeast Ohio towns and ZIP codes with approximate centre coordinates, used to turn a typed ZIP or town into a location (SMS cannot send GPS). Add rows to cover more of the region. Rows marked zip_only cover every other Ohio ZIP code, added from the GeoNames postal code table (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0): they are matched by ZIP code, and by town name only through the free-text reader, because some of those town names are also everyday words.
